cases.sentence: Как-то ночью Илий, чьи глаза ослабели настолько, что он едва мог видеть, лежал на своем ___.
cases.explain: «обычном месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),

cases.sentence: Господь позвал Самуила в ___, и Самуил поднялся, пришел к Илию и сказал:
cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.

cases.sentence: Господь пришел и встал там, призывая, как в первый и во ___:
cases.explain: «второй раз» — after the preposition «во», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”

cases.sentence: Весь Израиль от Дана до Вирсавии признал, что Самуил − ___ Господа.
cases.explain: «истинный пророк» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.
